title: Orion and Osiris symbolism in the Apollo patch
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Orion and Osiris symbolism in the Apollo patch, about 1960s at NASA, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But, look again. Behind the A is the constellation Orion. And the crossbar of the A is deliberately aligned with Orion's belt.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the patch for Apollo, NASA's 1960s programme to send people to the Moon, hides an ancient symbol. He says the constellation Orion sits behind the big letter A, with the crossbar of the A lined up on purpose with Orion's belt, and he links this to Osiris, the Egyptian god associated with Orion. If true, it would mean the space programme deliberately wove old religious symbols into its emblems.
